question: Explain how electric current is produced in a forward biased p-n junction. Why does current increase when the forward bias voltage is increased?

options.A: The electric current decreases because an increased voltage widens the depletion region barrier.
options.B: The electric current through the p-n junction increases with increase in forward bias voltage.
options.C: The current remains entirely unchanged because majority carriers are blocked completely at higher voltage limits.
options.D: The current turns into an alternating flow because the junction potential barrier fluctuates periodically.
